en: Hm? Let me think...
Well, they're actually pretty fun.
I'm glad to hear that, sir!
Honestly, they're boring.
Oh... Sorry, sir.
Don't you think they're kinda too easy?

That's not true of the latter half.
They'll knock <font_kind=yakuza_italic>anyone's</font_kind> socks off.
They're way too hard right now.

Huh?
Are you sure...?

Regardless, these challenge courses are my life.
They're going to help me achieve my dream.

That's right, sir. It may sound strange,
but I want to bring rise to the world's best batter!

According to my calculations, clearing
each and every challenge will help greatly.

Only then can someone truly become
the number one batting phenomenon!

Unfortunately, all my other customers only
have eyes for the simpler home run challenges.

That's why seeing you play the challenge courses
is so exciting! It really sets my heart aflutter.

Interesting.
And how'd you arrive at this dream?

I actually used to play baseball myself.
My colleagues always called me the data guy.

With my advanced simulation abilities,
I managed to develop into a pretty excellent catcher.
But one day, I had a thought.

What if there was a way to use my logical disposition
and baseball knowledge to benefit the sport as a whole?

I get it now.
That's why you made these challenge courses.

Exactly! I want to make the world's next great slugger!
An admirable dream, isn't it?

I guess.
I hope it works out for you.

Thanks! Oh, that's right!
I actually just finished a new trial course yesterday!

If it's all right with you,
would you mind giving it a shot, sir?
Me?

That's right. Before I set it loose on the public,
I want to see just how tough it really is.

Let me get this straight.
You want me to be your guinea pig?

That's not an elegant way to put it,
but roughly that, yeah!
Hm... Sounds like a hassle.
Huh!? Don't be so harsh, sir!

Nobody else has ever tried the challenge courses
more than once. I need <font_kind=yakuza_italic>you</font_kind>, sir!
These things are really unpopular, huh?

I'm begging you! If you manage to clear my challenge,
I'll do anything you ask of me, sir!
Anything?
Yes! I promise!

Oh, and you should know, you'll need to hit five
home runs in a row for this course. That's the goal.
I have complete faith in you, sir.

Thank you so much, sir!
I wish you the absolute best of luck.
Sorry, I'm not interested.

If you ever happen to reconsider,
please let me know right away, sir.

Ah! Hello, sir.
Would you like to try my trial challenge?

(Yoshida <font_kind=yakuza_italic>did</font_kind> say he'd do anything
I ask if I managed to clear his trial...)

Aw...
That was a nice try, sir.

Please come again if you're ever
feeling up to the challenge!

Ohhh!
That was incredible, sir!

Hm... This data should prove truly invaluable!
I can't thank you enough!

And in return, as promised,
I'll do anything you ask of me.

Oh, I almost forgot.
I'm not sure what to ask for, though.

Is there anything you want?
Just tell me what it is.

Hmm, this is tough.
Let me see...
I want everything you own.

Huh!? I-I can't do that!
I wouldn't last a day without my stuff!
What was that? You said you'd do <font_kind=yakuza_italic>anything</font_kind>.

You're giving off a serious yakuza vibe right now, sir.
Please keep it a little more reasonable...

Ugh, fine.
In that case...
Be my friend.

Huh? Your friend?
I think I can manage that, sir.

Ah, hold on a second.
Will I be your first friend in this fine city?
N-No, it's nothing like that.

I have to wonder, though.
What does being your friend entail?

Do you like to spend time with friends on your days off?
Actually, what do you do in your free time, sir?

Good question. It's usually a variety of things.
Hanging around in bars, playing baseball...
Sir! You're on a baseball team!?
Hm? Yeah.

That's incredible. As I think you can tell based
on my profession, I absolutely adore baseball.
I've wanted to join a pick-up team for a while.
Hm, is that so?

Yeah! You know, playing sports with your friends
is a great way to get closer to them!

In that case, why don't you come join my team?
We could really use another fresh face.
Of course! I'd love to!

I just remembered,
you used to play baseball, right?
Huh? Yes, sir. I did.

Great.
I want you to join my team.
Huh? You really want <font_kind=yakuza_italic>me</font_kind>, sir?

Yeah.
We could really use another fresh face.

All right, then.
If you insist, sir.
By the way, what's the team called?
We're the Setouchi Warriors.
Hm? Setouchi...?

That's right.
We're based in Onomichi, down in Hiroshima.

H-Hiroshima!?
You mean it's not in Tokyo!?
Nope! Didn't I mention that?
Y-You definitely didn't...
Damn. So you can't do it, then.

No, I said I'd do anything you asked.
I'll join your team, sir!

Yes! It shouldn't cost too much
to take a night bus down for games!
Oh, I almost forgot to ask you your name, sir.

If we're going to be teammates,
we should at least address each other properly.

Agreed. The name's Kiryu.
I'm the captain of the Warriors.

Wonderful. I can't wait to get out
on the diamond with you, Captain Kiryu!
Yeah, likewise.
Ya sounded real good in there, man.

And the power behind your bat's
clearly comin' from those massive legs of yours.

I ain't ever seen ya around, though.
You not a pro, guy?

Nope, I play on an amateur team.
Who exactly are you?

I'm Norikazu Nakahata. But since I'm as tough
as a wild gorilla, everyone calls me Gori-san.
Gori-san...?

Damn right. Back in my playin' days,
I was real famous-like. Ya don't know me?

Well, I don't really follow pro sports.
You're retired, I take it?

Nah, I'm just takin' a little break right now.
I could totally start goin' again whenever I wanted.

It's been rough, though. The league's kinda
left me out to dry 'cause of my attitude.

Hm, how am I gonna put this? Let's just say
I talked back to my coaches one too many times.

I don't think that's a problem.
It's good to question authority now and then.

Ya got a good head on your shoulders, dude.
You n' I are gonna get along good.

Oh yeah!
Ya said you play amateur ball, right?
Whaddya think of me joinin' your team?
What? Are you sure?

Sure as shit!
But don't forget, I'm an ex-pro.

I've gotta see if you're up to snuff.
Make sure if it's really worth joinin' ya.
Huh. And how are you gonna do that?

Good question, my man.
Whaddya say to a home run competition!?

If ya can manage to hit more home runs
than me, I'll gladly join up with ya.

Good call, guy!
Welp, I'm gonna get this party swingin'!

Phew, 7's my total.
Wasn't half bad.

C'mon, your turn now. If ya can even
match my total, I'll give ya the W.

The chance to get a guy like this on the Warriors
won't come along every day. I can't lose.
Huh. Y-Ya sure?

Meh, whatevs. I'm always hangin' around here,
so come talk to me if ya change your mind.

Oh, ya came. Well?
Ya here to try n' beat my score?

If ya manage to beat me,
I'll get all up in that team of yours!

What a bummer, my man.
I won this time.
Welp, come on back if ya ever wanna go again!

If ya can hit 7 or more outta the park,
I'll join your team like promised!

Oh, what's up, guy?
Ya here to beat my score?
Let's see what ya got, then.

If ya can get 7 or more home runs, ya win.
Oh n' as promised, I'll join your team.
Hm? How 'bout that.

Ya got moves, buddy!
I totally lose.

Life'll be easy if I'm on a team with a tough guy
like you. As I promised, I'll join ya.
Glad to hear it.
Anyways, what's your team called?
S-Setouchi...?
Hold up. Ain't that, uh...

Oh, sorry. I should've mentioned sooner.
My team's based in Onomichi down in Hiroshima.

H-Hiroshima!?
But... ya don't play in Tokyo!?

You heard me.
Don't tell me that's too far for you.

Naw, I promised! N' I never break promises!
I'll go to the end of the earth if ya want me to!
So you're in?

Hell yeah! I've been doin' nothin' but practice for ages.
I wanna shake the rust off n' break out the big guns!

Good.
Well, I'll see you down there, Gori-san.

What's with this place?
How can a cat café not have any cats!?

W-We'll have them back soon, Ma'am.
I promise...

<font_kind=yakuza_italic>Soon</font_kind>!? Don't take me for a fool!
I'm done with this dingy café for good!
Can't say I blame her...
A cat café with no cats...?
Hi<symbol=em_dash_with_outline>iiieee! I-I-Is this an extortion!?

Please spare me... I don't have any money...
I've been in the red because of this cat-less cat café...
Hang on, I'm not tryin' to extort you.
Huh? Really? Oh...! Are you a customer!?
Welllcome! Please, please, this way!
H-Hey...!
Geez, you're a terrible listener...
Welcome, sir, to the Nyan Nyan Café!
What is this place?

I'm glad you asked, sir! The Nyan Nyan Café
is a paradise for coffee and cat lovers alike!

The combination of cute and caffeinated will
leave you energized all day long. At least, it <font_kind=yakuza_italic>would</font_kind>...

You certainly talk big, buddy...
but I don't see any cats.
Look right this way, sir!

That's our number one cat...
Brittany-chan!

Hey, Brittany-chan! Come here!
Who's a good girl?
Man. This isn't your thing, huh?

I adore my feline friends, sir,
but I'm honestly bad with them.
Even though you're the manager of a cat café?

Yes, sir. I adore my feline friends,
but <font_kind=yakuza_italic>they</font_kind> don't care for </font_kind>me very much.

I'm okay with domesticated cats,
but other cats won't even look at me.

Hmm, that's pretty rough.
So, is that the only cat you have?

Yes, sir. The others, they...
They all ran away.

That's right. I had gathered a few
adorable furballs for our grand opening...

...but none of them respected me.
When I wasn't looking, they all darted off.
And so Brittany is the only one who's left...

Yeah... Brittany-chan doesn't really like me
either, though. She just failed to escape.

I guess I just can't really hang
in this cutthroat industry, huh?

I wouldn't say you're <font_kind=yakuza_italic>un</font_kind>qualified,
but you're not exactly qualified either.

No use crying over spilt milk.
You should just buy more cats.

I can't do that! I used all my savings on this place.
My wallet's run dry.

Besides, I already decided this café
is gonna exclusively shelter strays.
Why strays?

Well, most cafés are devoted to high-pedigree breeds,
so street walkers never get any love.

I'm gonna set myself apart by bringing
the runts out into the spotlight!

Naturally, any paw-pals we bring in will
get a full grooming and special orientation.

Huh... So it's a humanitarian thing, too.
I've never heard of something like this.

But strays are super good at avoiding people.
Whenever I approach 'em, they just scamper off.

I wish I could find ones that would be okay
with spending their lives pleasing the public.
Don't be ridiculous. That's not possible.

What?
...<font_kind=yakuza_italic>Me</font_kind>?

I guess if I have to...
There, there.

Y-You're incredible, sir! Brittany-chan doesn't
warm up to <font_kind=yakuza_italic>anyone</font_kind> like this! This is amazing!

Are you sure?
She seems pretty friendly to me.

I promise. Brittany-chan's never been
like this with any of my customers.

Maybe you have a hidden power, sir!
The power to befriend cats...!
Ah, that's it!

Um, if it's all right with you,
I could really use some help.
I... need you to gather stray cats for me.

That's right. With my frankly lacking charm,
it's impossible for me to round them up.

But you, you have the skills to get them
used to spending time with people...!

And once they trust humankind, you'll scoop
them up for your café. That's it, right?
Yeah! Isn't it a great idea!?
Ah! Don't leave!
Pleeease! My life depends on this...!
I don't care. Why should I go through all that trouble?

You should just give up on being a stray cat
specialist and borrow money to buy cats instead.
But... stray cats are...
Why do they have to be strays?
I mean... don't you feel bad for them?

It's not just Brittany-chan.
All cats deserve love.

The high-pedigree ones, the dirty ones on the street...
It doesn't matter what breed they are.

If there's a furry friend in need,
I want to help them push onward.

But strays get rounded up by animal control...
and almost always get put to sleep.

They're especially strict on that in Kamurocho.
I can't let that continue.
I want to save every last one.

And I want people to see that strays are just
as cute as regular cats once you wash 'em off.
